select
crm_Date, weekdayname,b.*
from eds.eds_ctl a
right join eds.date_dim b
on a.crm_Date=b.fulldate
where b.business_day_flag='N'
and fulldate>=cast('2023-10-09' as date)
order by fulldate

update eds.eds_ctl set crm_Date=cast('2023-10-13' as date)
